item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu: A selection of fresh seasonal vegetables that you can combine with a protein of your choice to create your own meal salad.

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu: Paprika stew with chicken and potatoes, whole bone-in chicken thighs seasoned with sweet and smoked paprika, served in the paprika stew with vegetables and potatoes and topped with herbs. Served with a refreshing “grandma's salad” of little gem, radishes, peas and dill with grandma's dressing on the side. The dish is gluten free. (6)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu: Mexican chicken, crispy spiced chicken and vegetables, served with Mexican red rice and topped with a spoonful of pico de gallo. Served with jalapeños, coriander, refried beans, chilli sauce and crème fraîche. The dish is gluten free. (6+11+13+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Mexican cauliflower and portobello, crispy spiced cauliflower, portobello and vegetables, served with Mexican red rice and topped with a spoonful of pico de gallo. Served with jalapeños, coriander, refried beans, chilli sauce and crème fraîche. The dish is gluten free. (6+11+13+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu: Greek-inspired shepherd's pie with lamb from Vibygård, topped with black olives, red onion and fresh oregano. (6+15) GREEN DISH: Dish GREEN DISH: moussaka, the one we all know and love, topped with olives, red onion and fresh oregano. (6+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu: Lasagne, Italy's anti-depressant weapon no. 1. (1+6+13+15) GREEN DISH: Dish GREEN DISH: lasagne, Italy's anti-depressant weapon no. 2. (1+6+13+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu: Sfincione with garlic chicken and spinach, Sicilian pizza with sun-dried tomatoes, topped with parmesan and oregano after baking, served with a rocket salad tossed in lemon vinaigrette. Served with roasted Italian-spiced vegetables, jalapeños, aioli and chilli sauce. Also available gluten free and dairy free. (1+2+6+11+13+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Sfincione with garlic mushrooms and spinach, Sicilian pizza with sun-dried tomatoes, topped with parmesan and oregano after baking, served with a rocket salad tossed in lemon vinaigrette. Served with roasted Italian-spiced vegetables, jalapeños, aioli and chilli sauce. Also available gluten free and vegan. (1+2+6+11+13+15)
